map_info.name: Box Noise
map_info.title: Box Noise
map_info.description: Walk the stepped shell on the left and the box-sampled cells on the right. Both read the preceding cellular fields once per box. Square exposed faces retain a block boundary; the flat floors and cut passages remain usable. This map uses box noise to mean piecewise-constant box sampling, not a separate named noise generator.

learning_objectives: Compare interpolated surfaces with piecewise-constant occupancy
Separate visible box boundaries from walkable clearance

documentation.summary: Walk the stepped shell on the left and the box-sampled cells on the right. Both read the preceding cellular fields once per box. Square exposed faces retain a block boundary; the flat floors and cut passages remain usable. This map uses box noise to mean piecewise-constant box sampling, not a separate named noise generator.
documentation.layout: Two full-scale rooms flank a clear north-south aisle. Their south-facing entrances open onto the cross-aisle at z=34. The exit is centred on the last row.
documentation.size_reason: A 69 m width preserves the two 28 m room footprints and a shared passage at scale 1.
